L93: #### Financial Assistance
L94: 
L95: Compassionate care is at the core of AMC’s mission, and we offer a variety of financial assistance programs based on need and eligibility, as well as a guide to external organizations that help with veterinary costs.
L96: 
L97: 【45†Image: A small black dog in a veterinary professional's arms】
L98: #### AMC's Options for Financial Aid
L99: 
L100: 【46†Image: A seeing eye dog in AMC's waiting room】
L101: 
L102: AMC’s financial assistance programs provide subsidized care for eligible pet owners and animal-related charities and rescue organizations.
L103: 
L104: 【47†LEARN MORE】
L105: 
L106: #### Outside Sources of Financial Aid
L107: 
L108: 【48†Image: An orange rescue cat in AMC's ICU】
L109:

L113: #### Our Blog
L114: 
L115: Written by staff oncologist and internist, Dr. Ann Hohenhaus, AMC’s weekly blog is an engaging and educational resource for pet owners looking for pet health tips and information.

L120: #### Ask the Vet Podcast
L121: 
L122: In partnership with Sirius XM, the Schwarzman Animal Medical Center presents ‘Ask the Vet,’ a podcast all about the pets we love and how to care for them. Dr. Ann Hohenhaus answers questions for pet parents, chats with leading animal experts, and talks about the most concerning issues for our furry friends.

L226: #### Referral Form & Procedures
L227: 
L228: 【67†Image: A cat at AMC】
L229: 
L230: Access all of the information you need to refer your patients to the Schwarzman Animal Medical Center.
L231: 
L232: 【13†Learn More】
L233: 
L234: #### Referral Coordinators
L235: 
L236: 【68†Image: A group shot of the Animal Medical Centers Referral Coordinators】
L237: 
L238: AMC’s Referral Coordinators work with referring veterinarians to ensure coordinated patient care and communication before, during, and after all consultation appointments and procedures.
L239: 
L240: 【69†Learn More】
L241: #### Send & Receive Medical Records
L242: 
L243: 【70†Image: Retrieving a dog in AMCs makeshift waiting room】
L244: 
L245: To ensure optimal patient care, AMC makes it easy to share medical records with our specialty services.
L246: 
L247: 【71†Learn More】
L248: #### Postgraduate Education
L249: 
L250: 【72†Image: A group of veterinary professionals examines a dog on an exam table】
L251: 
L252: The Anna-Maria and Stephen Kellen Institute for Postgraduate Education features comprehensive curricula including our Externship Program, Internship Program, and Residency Program.
L253: 
L254: 【73†Learn More】
L255: #### Continuing Education
L256: 
L257: 【74†Image: Dr. Mark Macina lectures at the Animal Medical Center】
L258: 
L259: As part of our ongoing commitment to education, the Schwarzman Animal Medical Center hosts regular lectures and conferences led by the top minds in veterinary medicine.
L260: 
L261: 【75†Learn More】
L262: 
L263: #### rDVM Newsletter
L264: 
L265: 【76†Image: Covers of recent rDVM Quarterly Newsletters】
L266: 
L267: Sign up for our rDVM newsletters to stay up to date with the latest news and clinical guidance from AMC’s staff.
L268: 
L269: 【77†Learn More】
L270: #### Research
L271: 
L272: The advancement of veterinary knowledge is central to the Schwarzman Animal Medical Center’s mission, and our staff regularly undertakes pioneering research to make sure we’re able to provide the best possible outcomes for our patients.
L273: 
L274: 【78†Image: A veterinarian looking into a microscope】
L275: #### About Research at AMC
L276: 
L277: 【79†Image: Veterinarians examine diagnostic images】
L278: 
L279: Through our Caspary Research Institute, AMC veterinarians work to understand the origins of diseases, to develop preventive measures, and ultimately to achieve cures.
L280: 
L281: 【80†Learn More】
L282: #### Clinical Trials
L283: 
L284: 【81†Image: Two medical professionals closely examine a rabbit who sits on an examination table】
L285: 
L286: For more than 50 years, AMC has conducted clinical trials to contribute new scientific knowledge and improve the medical and surgical care for animals.
L287: 
L288: 【82†Learn More】
L289: #### Being a Veterinary Technician at AMC
L290: 
L291: Being a Veterinary Technician at the Schwarzman Animal Medical Center is a highly rewarding career in a role that’s critical to the lifesaving care we deliver every day. Our Veterinary Technicians are trusted team members with a high degree of leadership and decision authority, and our culture of learning supports our LVTs with opportunities for mentorship, advancement, and growth.
L292: 
L293: 【83†Learn More】
L294: 
L295: 【84†Image: A Licensed Veterinary Technician with a dog】
L296: #### The Ann and Charles Johnson One Health Institute
L297: 
L298: The Ann and Charles Johnson One Health Institute supports the One Health approach to medicine, recognizing the growing connection between the health of animals, people, and the environment.
L299: 
L300: 【85†Learn More】
L301: 
L302: 【86†Image: Dr. Allyson Berent lectures at AMC's One Health Conference】
L303: #### Alumni Relations
L304: 
L305: Since 1964, thousands of veterinarians have graduated from AMC’s postgraduate education programs. We’re immensely proud of the wide ranging achievements and contributions of our alumni.
L306: 
L307: 【87†Alumni Relations】
L308: 
L309: 【88†Image: AMC's 1991 Class of Interns】
L310: #### 2026 Pet Holidays and Veterinary Awareness Days
L311: 
L312: Public education is one of AMC’s founding principles and an enduring mission. Use this calendar to spread awareness of common pet health topics among your veterinary clients, colleagues, family, and friends.
L313: 
L314: 【89†Learn More】

L379:

L394:
